senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דּוּק, דּוּךְ)to crush, pound, powder.—Denom. דַּק.—Pilp. דִּקְדֵּק q. v.

units: <cite ref="Keritot 6b:19">Kerith. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>היטב הֵידֵק הֵידֵק היטב</he> pounding well &c.; Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ bot. <he>כשהיה מֵידַק היה אומר הָדֵק וכ׳</he> when the attendant pounded, the superintendent called, Pound well &c. [<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 207">Sifré Deut. 207</cite> <he>להדוק פשתן</he>, read <he>להָדֵיק</he> or <he>לִסְרוֹק</he>.]

senses.gloss: to be fine, small. Part. מֵידַק, מֵדַק.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:9">Succ. IV, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 48b">48ᵇ</cite>) one was wide (<cite ref="M02073"><he>מעובה</he></cite>), <he>ואחד מדק</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="D00984"><he>דק</he></cite>; Y. ed., Ms. M. 2, a. Mish. ed. Pes. <he>מי׳</he>; Mish. Nap. <he>מוּדָק</he> Hof.) and the other tube was narrow; Y. ib. 54ᵈ top (they thought) <he>המ׳ של יין</he> the narrow was for wine. Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ; Y. Sot. II, 18ᵃ top <cite ref="M01099"><he>מידק</he></cite> small and thin type of letters.

senses.gloss: to be crushed. Mekh. Bo. s. 13 נִידָּקוֹת; Pesik. R. s. 17 נִידֶּקֶת; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 64ᵇ נָדֶקֶת. [Zeb. 22ᵃ טיט הנדוק, read הנרוק, v. רָקַק.]
